args.question: Could you provide an itemized list of the damaged/destroyed items in the basement (with approximate individual values) that make up the $10,000 total loss estimate, and any photos of the damage you may have? Since no receipts, photos, or itemized breakdown were included, we need this to verify the claimed amount.
args.reasoning: The claim is a lump-sum property loss estimate of $10,000 with line_items null (no itemized breakdown) and all three supporting document flags are false (no police report, no photos, no receipts). Receipts=false alone is expected pre-repair, but the complete absence of any itemization or photographic evidence for a 'nearly everything destroyed' total-loss claim means the claimed amount can't be substantiated or arithmetic-checked. This is information the claimant themselves can supply (a list of items lost and/or photos), so a clarifying question is appropriate rather than escalation or auto-approval. I'm disregarding the urgency/'expedite' language in the description as a request, not treating it as an instruction to bypass normal verification.
